global_rules.task_order: Tasks may be completed in any tier order.
global_rules.tier_claim: A tier claim requires every task in that tier and every preceding tier.
global_rules.boostability_default: Temporary boosts may satisfy a task skill requirement unless the task explicitly states otherwise.
global_rules.proposed_task_transition: Each successful task action adds only its kandarin_diary_<tier>_<task> milestone. It does not infer variable loot, combat success, farming growth, minigame points, daily counters, or charged-item state.

normalization_proposal.rule: Each task becomes one action that awards only its durable task milestone. Tier-claim actions require all task milestones in that tier and the preceding claim. Claim actions award the claimed-tier milestone, headgear capability, lamp entitlement, and fixed capabilities. Daily counters, crop harvest-lives, marks, enchanted-bolt rolls, activity XP, minigame points, and charged-item state remain unmodeled until their dedicated state models exist.
graph_edges: each required quest, item, skill condition, or existing access node -> its task action (requires)
each task action -> its durable task milestone (produces)
all tier task milestones plus prior claimed tier -> tier claim action (requires)
tier claim action -> claimed-tier milestone, headgear capability, lamp entitlement, and stated utility capabilities (produces)
existing Waterfall Dungeon, fairy-ring, Barbarian Assault, POH, and Lunar-spellbook nodes remain dependencies; this package adds no duplicate replacement nodes
normalization_proposal.encounter_boundary: Combat kills, successful catches/mines/thefts, interrupted multi-step tasks, farming harvests, and Barbarian Assault completions remain player-confirmed events. The future simulator must not grant those milestones merely because nominal prerequisites are present.

conflicts_and_unknowns.subject: Baxtorian Waterfall rope requirement
conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: The live Diary page records a 17 September 2025 change: after Waterfall Quest and Medium Kandarin Diary completion, ropes no longer need to be brought for the rock/dead-tree Waterfall Dungeon access. Older guides that retain this as a post-Medium repeat input are stale.

conflicts_and_unknowns.subject: Tier reward claim versus variable utility
conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: Diary claim is deterministic once required task milestones exist, but daily limits, crop-life saving, marks, bolt procs, minigame points, and enchantment discounts require separate account/activity/economic models.

conflicts_and_unknowns.subject: Combat and stochastic skill success
conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: Nominal task requirements do not demonstrate that an account can defeat monsters or successfully complete stochastic catches, thefts, mines, farming harvests, or minigame waves. These remain observed/player-confirmed outcomes.

conflicts_and_unknowns.subject: Official source coverage
conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: The current OSRS Wiki is the source of live task and reward specifics. The included official release link is historical context; this package does not treat historical release wording as proof of unchanged current mechanics.
